entries.title: Google Play Store: Browsing with Firefox is no longer supported on Android
entries.author: gphilip
entries.current_title: Google Play Store: Browsing with Firefox is no longer supported on Android
entries.excerpt: When I try to open play.google.com from Firefox on my Android device I get: This browser is no longer supported. Please use the Google Play Store app to access Google Play. My Firefox version is 35.0, which is the latest version for Android. So it looks like the walls are going up around that particular garden as well.

entries.title: Ask HN: TrueCrypt audit status?
entries.author: mukmuk
entries.excerpt: After raising over $70,000 from the community in October 2013, progress on the TrueCrypt audit has been fitful at best. The last update on http://istruecryptauditedyet.com was April 14, 2014. Two key contributors, Matthew Green (https://twitter.com/matthew_d_green) and Kenn White (https://twitter.com/kennwhite) remain active on Twitter. I am aware of VeraCrypt and CipherShed but these appear orthogonal to the original audit. Does anyone know what the heck is going on?
entries.guide_zh: 社区筹款已久而更新不多，作者追问 TrueCrypt 安全审计的进展。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to manage developers who aren't very good?
entries.author: marktangotango
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to manage developers who aren't very good?
entries.excerpt: Before becoming a team lead, I was the type of developer who, when given a task, would dig into the application api's, the database schema, the configuration, whatever it took to fill in the gaps to accomplish the task. Sure I'd get stumped sometimes, but I'd always try to ask for help sooner rather than later. Now, I'm a lead of 4 developers. Two are like I was, I can give them a task, they'll go do it with minimal guidance. The other two will spend hugely more time on tasks
entries.guide_zh: 带团队后遇到能力较弱的开发者，如何管理、指导并安排他们的工作？

entries.title: Google deleted whocalled.us for “Pure Spam” and replaced it with spam
entries.author: whocalledus
entries.current_title: Google deleted whocalled.us for “Pure Spam” and replaced it with spam
entries.excerpt: In November Google completely removed whocalled.us from their search results. It was the first site of its kind, created in 2005 for crowdsourced info about telemarketing numbers. There were scripts for people to utilize in their VoIP boxes, and it was a good honest site. Google has been trying to weed out telephone spam in their results, and for some reason they deleted the original instead of the useless empty shell sites that spam every possible telephone number combinatio
entries.guide_zh: 站长称 whocalled.us 被谷歌按垃圾站移除，却让位给了真正的垃圾内容。
